hook.name: NFTStrategyHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for NFTStrategy pools that enforces factory-only pool creation and liquidity addition, applies a block-decaying buy fee (starting at 99%, falling ~1 point per ~12s to a floor of 10%) while sells stay at 10%, distributes collected fees in ETH — 80% to the strategy, 10% to the launcher, 10% to a protocol address — and blocks exact-output swaps. Token fees are converted to ETH via a nested swap in afterSwap.
